title: Write-once capsule ownership
objective: Make immutable UInt64 capsule ownership write-once and registry-authenticated

oracles: duplicate-owner, same-owner forgery, transplant, and GC regressions
exceptions: Private WeakMap ownership registry is a representation invariant unavailable to mathematical Python

handoff.summary: Added a private owner-to-capsule WeakMap enforcing one write-once capsule per owner identity. Creation reserves the owner before reading an arbitrary source and rolls the reservation back on failure; authorization and copying additionally verify that the owner registry still names the exact capsule. Neutral tests cover duplicate creation, same-owner forgery, cross-owner transplantation, failed and reentrant creation, and collection of owner/capsule/lease cycles.
risks: An owner intentionally supports exactly one capsule for its lifetime; consumers needing multiple independent packed stores must allocate distinct private owner objects.
next_steps: Cantor integration should create the capsule while constructing the private prepared owner and reject any later rebound capsule before native or copied fallback use.
Run the focused capsule suite on required non-x64 platforms in integration CI.
